lastReleaseMessage: DEPLOY.md: record the one-time setup as done and drop the destructive Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .git step from the runbook

barRaise.topFinding: The app itself did not regress: security, dependency, and compliance all still score in the 90s, and the three test suites remain green. This run's fuller domain-lens pass (generative-art and a deeper orchestration sweep) found real shipped-output defects the lighter checks were missing. The 43/199 over-cap herb descriptions don't just truncate mid-word in the editor preview, they truncate mid-word in the actual print and PNG output too. A fresh generative-art pass found 39 of 199 herbs (20%) render with a near-invisible border and glow because three category accent colors fall below 3:1 contrast against the parchment paper. Release-pipeline hygiene has a real gap: push-yae-mirror.ps1, the step that actually pushes the live site, still carries the PS 5.1 git-stderr bug fixed one script over on 2026-07-31 and never propagated. Housekeeping found a queue-process failure matching the exact pattern found on Scheduler the same day: a batch operation marked a real, still-open finding as completed using an unrelated project's completion note. Health drops from 82 to 75 and the verdict flips from working to needs-attention on the strength of confirmed shipped-output defects, not on health score alone.

actions.title: Fix the mid-word truncation at the source: word-boundary-aware slice in editor.js:693, since 43/199 herb records now confirmed to print and PNG-export cut off mid-word, not just preview.
Write a project-owned audit-report-to-dashboard sync script; the published low:1 count contradicts the 7 LOW items the linked report actually carries.

Derive a review-freshness signal from barRaise.latestReportAt and publish it as a field; the prior run's own recommended fix was never implemented and the blind spot is now 6 days, not the original 2.
Darken 3 of 10 herb-category accent colors (39/199 herbs) that fall below 3:1 contrast against the parchment label paper, rendering borders/glow near-invisible.

Route push-yae-mirror.ps1's git calls through Invoke-Git; it still has the PS 5.1 stderr-wrap + LASTEXITCODE-clobber bug fixed only in push-to-github.ps1, and it's the step that pushes the live site mirror.
Confirm queue-drain-hourly is actually firing; 13 pending Apothecary queue items (oldest 19 days) have zero attempts, and the portfolio drain timestamp hasn't advanced in 5 days.
Redact the Claude model name from CHANGELOG.md line 610, a public GitHub-visible artifact naming the model directly, which the project's own AI-tells voice rule bans.
Add CHANGELOG.md to deploy-to-yae.ps1's copy list, or explicitly decide the mirror shouldn't carry one and delete the stale copy; the public mirror is still 15 releases behind at v0.5.0.
Route saved-labels.js (and ideally autofit.js/print.js) through main.js's ctx dynamic-import path; now confirmed as 7 static imports with three modules double-instantiated after a build-stamp change.
Extend test-data-integrity.mjs to assert the herb-record key union and all six documented character caps; this is exactly the check that would have auto-caught the descFull violations.
Rewrite README's Extending section to say drop the PNG and run regen-symbols-manifest.ps1 instead of hand-edit data/symbols.js, which the file's own header says gets clobbered on the next regen.

Route regen-symbols-manifest.ps1 and regen-textures-manifest.ps1 through the same Write-FileAtomic helper release.ps1 already defines; both write shipped data/*.js files via plain Set-Content with no readback.
Correct CLAUDE.md's Discord webhook table: only 3 of 5 documented webhooks exist, and the Audit Bot entry actually posts to #apothecary-resources via post-audit-digests.ps1.
Darken theme.latinColor; it falls short of WCAG AA text contrast against both paper gradient stops for every label's scientific-name text.
Rewrite editor.js's preset-minimal-front factory layout to derive zone geometry from the active template descriptor instead of hardcoding it.
Strip 785.9MB of orphaned data/ingredients/ raw-photo blobs from git history (repo is 866MB total, should be near 1.2MB); run git-filter-repo/BFG and force-push a rewritten history.

Add a HEAD-comparison pre-check to the daily audit/bar-raise routine so a no-op day republishes the prior report unchanged instead of spending a full LLM pass; 4+ consecutive identical-finding days so far.
Update .project-context.json scheduled_tasks/review_cadence to name nightly-sweep + bar-raise-rotating; both listed per-project tasks are retired.
Add the PS 5.1 stderr-wrap hazard and Invoke-Git pattern to CLAUDE.md's Things that will bite you; the hazard is documented only in script comments.
Add corporate-speak/hedging vocabulary (leverage, seamless, robust, delve, streamline) to solo-dev-voice-audit's Phase 3 pattern table; currently zero coverage.
Add index.html and src/ to .project-context.json's public_artifact_globs so the declared AI-tells scope matches CLAUDE.md's rule.
Add a fourth test suite covering the fuzzy herb-lookup alias/exact/prefix/contains chain that powers the flagship auto-fill flow; currently zero coverage.
Update CLAUDE.md's Deploy flow section to list all 6 steps release.ps1 actually runs; it currently describes only 5.
Decouple post-audit-digests.ps1 from release.ps1 so #apothecary-resources gets same-day digests; it currently only fires on release, leaving the channel 8 days / 3 reports behind.
Surface to Kane: is daily bar-raise plus nightly audit still proportionate for a feature-frozen, 100%-complete app with 3 weeks of doc-only commits and findings up to 13 runs stale.
